usedFor: Slack is where people post meeting links, and Meeting BaaS answers with “Sending a bot” to join that meeting.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Sending a bot” in Meeting BaaS
bestTemplate.why: A link dropped in a channel can send an AI bot into the meeting right away.

watchOut: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” includes bot messages, so a bot post can run “Sending a bot” too.
